title: CoreWeave debt raises concerns over AI industry financing
excerpt: CoreWeave bonds entered distressed territory as investors demand higher yields, prompting questions about a potential private credit bubble in the AI sector.
body_html:
Cloud provider CoreWeave experienced a difficult week as its bonds fell into distressed territory, defined by investors seeking 1,000 basis points more in yield compared to government bonds.

The shift in bond performance drew wider attention within the financial sector, including from investor Chamath Palihapitiya. Palihapitiya highlighted the distressed debt and raised questions about whether the broader artificial intelligence infrastructure buildout is connected to a private credit bubble.
